cases.expected: Returns a non‑null Iterator<RRset> whose hasNext() returns false for a newly created empty Zone.
cases.description: Verify that AXFR() on a fresh Zone (no records added) returns a valid iterator that reports no elements.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null Iterator<RRset> whose hasNext() returns true and next() returns the RRset containing the record that was added before the call.
cases.description: Add a simple A record to the Zone, then call AXFR() and confirm the iterator yields exactly one RRset containing that record.

cases.expected: Calling next() after the iterator is exhausted throws NoSuchElementException.
cases.description: After iterating over all RRsets returned by AXFR(), verify that a subsequent call to next() results in NoSuchElementException, confirming correct iterator contract.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null Iterator<RRset> whose hasNext() returns true for each distinct RRset added (e.g., SOA, NS, A, AAAA) and finally false after the last RRset.
cases.description: Add a SOA record, an NS record, two A records for the same name, and one AAAA record. Call AXFR() and verify the iterator yields exactly four RRsets in the expected order.

cases.expected: The first RRset returned by the iterator contains the SOA record; the second contains the NS record; subsequent RRsets contain the added A and AAAA records respectively.
cases.description: Confirm that AXFR() respects the conventional zone transfer ordering: SOA first, then NS, followed by other RRsets.

cases.expected: UnsupportedOperationException when calling remove() on the iterator returned by AXFR().
cases.description: Obtain the iterator via zone.AXFR(), advance it at least once, then invoke iterator.remove(). The ZoneIterator does not support element removal, so the call must throw UnsupportedOperationException.

cases.expected: ConcurrentModificationException when the underlying Zone is modified after the iterator has been created and before iteration completes.
cases.description: Create a Zone, add a couple of records, obtain an iterator with AXFR(), then add another record to the Zone before consuming the iterator. The iterator should detect the structural change and throw ConcurrentModificationException on the next hasNext() or next() call.

group: AXFR on zone with null origin

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) when AXFR() is invoked on a Zone whose origin Name is null.
cases.description: Construct a Zone instance using a constructor that allows a null origin (if such a constructor exists) or manually set the origin to null via reflection. Calling AXFR() should fail because a valid zone must have an origin; the implementation is expected to throw NullPointerException or IllegalArgumentException.

group: AXFR iterator illegal state after exhaustion

cases.expected: IllegalStateException when calling remove() after the iterator has been exhausted.
cases.description: Iterate through all RRsets returned by AXFR() until hasNext() returns false, then call iterator.remove(). Since the iterator is in a state where no current element exists, it must throw IllegalStateException.
